paper_title: Constraints on Axion-like Particles from a Hard X-ray Observation of Betelgeuse
notes: ALP-photon limit from NuSTAR hard X-ray observation of Betelgeuse (ALPs produced via Primakoff in the stellar core, reconverted in the Galactic B-field). Headline 95% CL curve traced from Fig.3 (e-print upperlimits_v0908.pdf), red-band UPPER SOLID line = most conservative stellar model (t_cc=1.55e5 yr) and B_T=0.4 uG; this is the robust bound the paper emphasizes: g_agamma<1.8e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a<3.5e-11 eV. The band lower/dashed (most optimistic, t_cc=3.6 yr, B_T=3.0 uG) reaches g<5.2e-12 for m_a<5.5e-11 eV. Plot is transposed (horizontal axis=g_agamma, vertical=m_a); calibrated g-axis from minor tick marks (2e-11@x=138.7, 9e-11@x=86.2), m-axis from decade ticks (38 px/dec), validated by reproducing both quoted flat-limit values. Curve is flat ~1.84e-11 for m<~3.5e-11 eV then weakens as sin^2(q)/q^2 drops; left edge (5.8e-12 eV) is the plot boundary, not a physical cutoff. Not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence.
